notes: Brasília has no official GTFS: the timetable is derived by Pathfinder from the Semob GeoServer (official lines, itineraries, stop positions and departure times). The stop pattern of each line is estimated (stops within 20 m of the itinerary) and stop times are interpolated by distance, so intermediate times are approximate.
Metrô-DF (stations layer only, no timetable) and Metrô-DF fares are not in this bundle; bus lines of the rural system (STPCR) are included when the Semob lists them.
The Semob layers 'Paradas de onibus' and 'Viagens Programadas por Linha' are broken on the server (database connection refused, 2026-11-22), which is why the stop pattern cannot be read directly.
Open-ended timetable rows are given a 30-day validity from the build date; the bundle is rebuilt daily.
